description: This file declares functions and constants related to Mazda trigger decoding shapes within the firmware. It includes initialization functions for various Mazda models and configurations, and defines a specific constant related to Mazda MiataNA.

methods.name: initializeMazdaMiataNaShape
methods.description: Initializes the trigger shape for Mazda Miata NA model.

methods.name: initializeMazdaMiataNb1Shape
methods.description: Initializes the trigger shape for Mazda Miata NB model, version 1.

methods.name: initializeMazdaMiataNb2Crank
methods.description: Initializes the crank trigger shape for Mazda Miata NB, version 2.

methods.name: initializeMazdaMiataVVtTestShape
methods.description: Initializes a test trigger shape for Mazda Miata VVT configurations.

methods.name: configureMazdaProtegeSOHC
methods.description: Configures trigger shape for Mazda Protege with SOHC engine.

methods.name: configureMazdaProtegeLx
methods.description: Configures trigger shape for Mazda Protege LX model.

methods.name: initialize_Mazda_Engine_z5_Shape
methods.description: Initializes a specific Mazda engine trigger shape.
